fields.Name: W5 -> S2.2
fields.Description: Gate G1.3 (phase 1, dataset W5, criterion S2.2): on W5 (seed 42) the unit excludes the 2,147 censored newest-cycle membership years, no censored row reaches the training matrix (0), and a dry-run score of the newest cycle has a mean prediction within 0.05 of that cycle's mean planted TrueP. It fails when the unit row reader skips the censoring step, so censored rows are trained on. The pipeline's single-feature dominance threshold is 0.75 (default 0.6) because AutoRenew is a planted true driver of the world generator (about 0.74 of importance), not leakage.
